resources.string: Isiguquli sombala womfanekiso asikwazanga ukuqala. Umfanekiso awungeniswanga.
Umfanekiso uneenkcukacha zombala ezingalunganga okanye ezingaxhaswayo.
Umfanekiso uphela ngaphakathi kweenkcukacha zawo zombala.
Lo mfanekiso usebenzisa imodeli yombala ye-ICC umfundi womfanekiso angakwaziyo ukuyiguqula. Qala ukhuphele ngaphandle ikopi ye-RGB kwi-app elawula imibala.
Ubungakanani bokuqala be-SVG bugqitha kwimida yobukhulu be-bitmap ye-Android. Ubungakanani abuguqulwanga.
I-SVG ayichazi ubungakanani bokuqala obusebenzisekayo. Abuthathelwanga indawo bubungakanani obusekelwe kwindawo yokuzoba.
%1$s eneefreyimu %2$s. I-AN Paint ihlela imifanekiso engashukumiyo kwaye ayigcini ukushukuma kwemifanekiso.
I-PNG enomfanekiso omiselweyo owahlukileyo. Kuya kungeniswa loo mfanekiso endaweni yeefreyimu zomfanekiso oshukumayo. Ukuwugcina kudala umfanekiso ongashukumiyo.
Kuya kungeniswa ifreyimu yokuqala kuphela. Ukugcina kudala umfanekiso ongashukumiyo.
%1$s enesakhiwo esintsonkothe kakhulu ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba ineefreyimu ezininzi na. I-AN Paint iya kuvula umfanekiso ongashukumiyo kuphela kwaye ayiyi kugcina nakuphi na ukushukuma.

Ibhala umbhalo ongenalufomatho ngoonobumba abakhanyayo nabamnyama. Wujonge ngefonti apho bonke oonobumba benobubanzi obulinganayo. Oku kukuboniswa komfanekiso kuphela; akunakuphinda kuvulwe njengomfanekiso wokuqala.
Le fayile igqitha kumda wokungenisa oyi-512 MiB. Khetha ifayile encinane.
Amaphepha e-PDF aguqulwa abe yimifanekiso kwi-144 dpi. Umbhalo nezinto ze-vector ziba ziipikseli.
Iinkcukacha zomdali womfanekiso, umthombo nelayisenisi azikwazanga ukugcinwa okanye ukubuyiselwa. Iinkcukacha ebezigciniwe ngaphambili zisekhona. Zama kwakhona.
Ezi nkcukacha zomdali womfanekiso, umthombo nelayisenisi zingabangela ukuba umzobo ugqithe kubungakanani obunokubuyiselwa. Umzobo wakho wangaphambili neenkcukacha zawo zigciniwe.
Ulwimi lwe-app\n\nIinguqulelo zigcinwa kwizibonelelo zolwimi ze-AN Paint. Umbhalo omtsha okanye ongekaguqulelwa uvela ngesiNgesi.
Ezinye iinkcukacha ezigciniweyo zabadali bemifanekiso, imithombo neelayisenisi azikwazanga ukufundwa. Iikopi zazo ezigciniweyo zisekhona.
Umfanekiso ogqityiweyo awukwazanga ukuthatha indawo yefayile ekhethiweyo.
Umfanekiso neendawo zenkumbulo zethutyana zokubhala ifomathi zigqitha kumda wenkumbulo wokukhuphela ngaphandle.
Umfanekiso ongashukumiyo onemibala efikelela kuma-256. Ukudala imibalabala kwenza utshintsho phakathi kwemibala lube mpuluswa. I-GIF eshukumayo ivulwa ngefreyimu yayo yokuqala.
Faka igama lefayile elingenazo iimpawu ze-slash okanye zokulawula.
Umgangatho ophezulu ugcina iinkcukacha ezininzi kwaye udla ngokwenza ifayile ibe nkulu.
Lo mfanekiso usebenzisa iprofayile yombala i-AN Paint engekakwazi ukuyiguqula. Wuguqulele kwi-sRGB PNG kumhleli olawula imibala ngaphambi kokuwungenisa.

%1$s Ikopi eyahlukileyo yokubuyisela igciniwe. Sebenzisa Ifayile > Khuphela ngaphandle ikopi yokubuyisela ukuze ugcine i-ZIP yayo. Khupha i-canvas.png kuyo uze ulayishe loo mfanekiso ukuze usebenzise iindlela eziqhelekileyo zokuguqula ubungakanani ukuba kuyimfuneko.
Umfanekiso omnye womthombo wengqokelela yemifanekiso awukho.
I-Android ayifumananga isikhethi sefayile. Vumela i-app ethi Files okanye Documents ukuba isebenze kwimimiselo ye-Android, uze uzame kwakhona.

Kuqikelelwa ukuba le ngqokelela yemifanekiso igqitha kumda wangoku wenkumbulo yokusebenza, nokuba kukubungakanani obuncinane kakhulu bokukhupha. Ukunciphisa ububanzi nobude bengqokelela kuphela akwanelanga phantsi kwemida yangoku. Vala amanye amaxwebhu okanye ulungise umfanekiso womthombo omncinane ngaphambi kokuzama kwakhona. Ingqokelela yakho ayitshintshanga.
Ukubhala umfanekiso ngefomathi yokugcina ngokuzenzekela kusilele.

%1$s Ukugcina ngokuzenzekela kumisiwe okwethutyana ukuze kukhuselwe loo msebenzi ongekagqitywa. Sebenzisa “Ifayile → Khuphela ngaphandle ikopi yokubuyisela…” ukuze uwugcine, kunye nokuthi “Ifayile → Gcina njenge…” (Ifomathi yefayile: PNG / JPEG) ukuze ugcine umsebenzi wakho wangoku.
Ukubhala indawo ekhethiweyo ngefomathi yokugcina ngokuzenzekela kusilele.
Ayikwazi ukudala uvimba wethutyana wokuhlehlisa. Khulula indawo yokugcina kwisixhobo uze uzame kwakhona.
Khetha ikopi encinane yokukhupha. Imifanekiso yomthombo nemimiselo yokunquma ihlala kwi-resolution yayo yokuqala.
Le fomathi kufuneka ifunde umfanekiso wayo womthombo okanye amacandelo awo omthombo ngaphambi kokuguqula ubungakanani. Okukhutshwayo okuncinane kusenokugqitha kwinkumbulo ekhoyo.
Ingqokelela yemibala. Cofa ukuze ukhethe owangaphambili; bamba ukuze ukhethe owangasemva. Skrola ukuze ubone eminye imibala.
Ukunquma kufuneka kuhlale ngaphakathi kwendawo yokuzoba.
Imboniselo yangaphambili yokunquma. Tsala umphetho okanye ikona; tsala ngaphakathi ukuze uhambise indawo yokunquma.

Iipikseli eziyi-%1$d × %2$d (%3$.2f MP) zigqitha kumda wangoku okhuselekileyo wokuhlela oyi-%4$.2f MP. I-AN Paint igcina wonke umfanekiso kwinkumbulo kwaye ibekela bucala indawo yokuguqulwa kwejiyometri yomfanekiso neendawo ezikhethiweyo. Inkumbulo ekhoyo yiyo ebeka lo mda. Khuphela ngaphandle i-ayikhoni, umbhalo we-Base64 okanye umzobo we-ASCII. Ukukhuphela ngaphandle akutshintshi umfanekiso wangoku okanye indawo yawo yangoku yokugcina.

Igcina iindawo zeepikseli ngokunxulumene nekona ephezulu ekhohlo. Ukunciphisa ububanzi okanye ubude bendawo yokuzoba kusika iipikseli ezigqitha kumphetho wasekunene okanye ongezantsi; Hlehlisa kuyazibuyisela.
Nokuba kubungakanani obuncinane kakhulu bokukhupha, lo mfanekiso awunakulayishwa ukuze uhlelwe phantsi kwemida yangoku yenkumbulo. Rhoxisa uze usebenzise umfanekiso womthombo omncinane.

Uqikelelo lwenkumbulo luquka indawo yokuzoba nendawo yeekopi yangoku, ukufunda umfanekiso ngokukhetha ezinye iipikseli ukuze kuncitshiswe i-resolution, neendawo zenkumbulo zethutyana zokuhlela. Igridi yeepikseli ivela xa ukwandisa kungama-800% okanye ngaphezulu. Iirula zibonisa iindawo ngeepikseli zomfanekiso.
Jonga iphepha lefayile ye-Commons lemephu nganye ukuze ubone umdali, ilayisenisi nendlela efunekayo yokukhankanya umdali. Utshintsho lunokubalwa njengomsebenzi ohlengahlengisiweyo.
Yongeza imifanekiso, uze utsale umfanekiso omncinane apha

Yongeza imifanekiso efikelela kuma-20 usebenzisa isikhethi seefayile se-Android. Itreyi engezantsi ibonisa imifanekiso emincinane, amagama eefayile, ubukhulu bemifanekiso emva kokunquma naluphi na uhlengahlengiso oluthi Ububanzi obufanayo okanye Ubude obufanayo, namaxesha okuguqulwa kweefayile xa umboneleli ewanika. Hlela ngegama lefayile okanye ngexesha lokuguqulwa; ukuhlela akutshintshi ulungiselelo lwemifanekiso ebekiweyo.

Cofa umfanekiso omncinane ukuze uwukhethe. Nquma umfanekiso unquma loo mfanekiso; Nquma ezininzi usebenzisa imida yeepikseli okanye yeepesenti kwimifanekiso ekhethiweyo. Tsala iziphatho zokunquma okanye uchwetheze amanani. Buyisela ukunquma ekuqaleni ibuyisela imiphetho yokuqala. Ukunquma akonakalisi umthombo kwaye kunokuhlehliswa.

Bamba umfanekiso omncinane, okanye utsale umfanekiso osele ukwindawo yokusebenza, uze uwubeke kumphetho oqaqanjisiweyo. Imboniselo yangaphambili ebonisa okungasemva ibonisa iziphumo ezichanekileyo zokuncamathela. Ukuncamathelisa ngasekunene kulungelelanisa umphezulu; ukuncamathelisa ngezantsi kulungelelanisa imiphetho yasekhohlo. Ungacofa nomfanekiso omncinane uze ucofe indawo ekujoliswe kuyo engu-+. Xa kuncanyathiselwa, umfanekiso wokuqala uqala kwindawo yokuqala. Imifanekiso encanyathiselweyo ingahamba xa kunqunywa umfanekiso ezincanyathiselwe kuwo. Ukugqumana akuvumelekanga xa kuncanyathiselwa.

Khetha umfanekiso uze usebenzise Indawo echanekileyo ukuze umisele indawo ye-X/Y yekona yawo ephezulu ngasekhohlo ngeepikseli ezipheleleyo, ukuqala kuziro. Eminye imifanekiso igcina iindawo zayo, kwaye ukugqumana kuvumelekile.

Ububanzi obufanayo nobuthi Ubude obufanayo bunika yonke imifanekiso efakiweyo ubukhulu obufanayo kwelo cala ngoxa kugcinwa umlinganiselo wobubanzi nobude bomfanekiso ngamnye. Khetha iipikseli, ipesenti, Eyona incinane okanye Eyona inkulu. Buyisela ubungakanani bokuqala isusa ukulinganisa ubukhulu kodwa igcina ukunquma.

Susa ekubekweni ibuyisela kuphela umfanekiso okhethiweyo kwitreyi. Eminye imifanekiso ihlala ibekiwe; imifanekiso encanyathiselweyo ingahamba ukuze ivale umsantsa. Susa icima kuphela loo mfanekiso ufakiweyo. Hlehlisa/Phinda wenze zibuyisela olu tshintsho. Tsala umfanekiso obekiweyo ukuze uwulungiselele kwakhona; ukutsala indawo engenanto kuhambisa okubonwayo. Sondeza okanye wahlule iminwe ukuze uguqule ubungakanani bokubuka. «Bonisa konke» ilungisa ubungakanani bokubuka ukuze ibonise yonke ingqokelela; ayiguquli ubukhulu bokukhutshwayo.

Gcina i-PNG igcina ngqo umfanekiso odityanisiweyo. Hlela kwi-Paint iwudlulisela kumhleli oyintloko njengento ethatha indawo yomfanekiso enokuhlehliswa. Ukuba okukhutshwayo kugqitha kumda wenkumbulo, khetha ikopi encinane yokukhupha ukuba inikiwe. Ukuba nokukhutshwayo okuncinane kakhulu kugqitha kumda, i-app ibonisa isilumkiso senkumbulo endaweni yesikhethi sobungakanani. Iifayile zokuqala zomthombo azitshintshi. Ingqokelela yangoku igcinwa kwisixhobo ize iphinde ivuleke xa ubuya.

Le mo isebenzisa iinkcukacha ezifanayo ze-Catrobat/AGPL nezabanikeli bezinto eziboniswe kwiphaneli yomhleli oyintloko ethi «Ifayile > Malunga, iilayisenisi nombulelo».
Ingqokelela inokuqulatha imifanekiso efikelela kuma-20. Susa umfanekiso ukuze wongeze omnye.
Umfanekiso awunakuncanyathiselwa kuwo ngokwawo okanye komnye wemifanekiso encanyathiselwe kuwo.

Khetha Ukubuka, Zoba, Ifayile, Hlela okanye Umbala ukuze ubonise izilawuli zaloo thebhu. Utolo olusecaleni kweethebhu luvala okanye lubuyisela iphaneli. Xa isikrini simi nkqo, iithebhu noluhlu lwezixhobo zihamba ngokuthe tye; ziskrole ukuze ufikelele kwezinye izilawuli. Xa isikrini sithe tyaba, iithebhu nezixhobo eziphambili zihamba ezantsi ngasekhohlo. Zoba iquka Umzobo, Ukhetho no-Faka. Umzobo udibanisa Ipensile, iBhrashi, Ipeyinti yamanzi ne-Ibhrashi yomoya. Ukhetho ludibanisa ukhetho oluxande noluzotywe ngokukhululekileyo. Faka idibanisa imigca, iimilo nombhalo. Cofa udidi ukuze ukhethe isixhobo esilukhumbulayo uze ubonise izixhobo nemimiselo yalo ngezantsi koluhlu xa isikrini simi nkqo, okanye ngasekunene xa sithe tyaba. Cofa udidi olukhethiweyo kwakhona ukuze uvale okanye uvule izixhobo nemimiselo yalo. Iindidi zikhumbula isixhobo sokugqibela esisetyenziswe kuzo ngelo xesha lokusebenza. Skrola iphaneli yokhetho ukuze ubone eminye imimiselo. Iheader iquka igama lefayile nezenzo ezikhawulezayo. Abanegalelo & imiqathango: «Ifayile > Malunga, iilayisenisi nombulelo».

Ithebhu Umbala iquka isibonisi sombala wangaphambili/wangasemva, Tshintshanisa imibala, Mnyama / mhlophe kunye no-Iqhubele phambili. Cofa indawo yangaphambili okanye yangasemva yesibonisi ukuze uhlele loo mbala. Ingqokelela yemibala esisiseko nemibala egciniweyo zingaphantsi kweheader. Cofa isampulu esisiseko ukuze ukhethe owangaphambili okanye ubambe ukuze ukhethe owangasemva. Iindawo ezine ezisekunene ekupheleni kwengqokelela yemibala esisiseko zigcina imibala esandula ukusetyenziswa; cofa ukuze ukhethe owangaphambili okanye ubambe ukuze ukhethe owangasemva. Umhleli wombala une-Ingqokelela yemibala, Iiseli zobusi kunye no-Iqhubele phambili. Iqhubele phambili iquka uluhlu lwemibala, ivili, RGB, HSV, HSL nezilawuli zehex ezinamanani amathandathu. Imibala elungiselelweyo iqala nge-Vayolethi eluthuthu #5B67FF, Igolide #FFD700, Isilivere #C0C0C0 no-Ubhedu #B87333. Cofa umbala ogciniweyo ukuze uwusebenzise njengowangaphambili; wubambe ukuze ukhethe owangasemva, uwuhlele okanye uwususe. Yongeza umbala okanye indawo engenanto yemibala egciniweyo ivula umhleli ukuze ugcine umbala. Uxwebhu oluyintloko alubonisi okungasemva kwalo. Ukulayisha umfanekiso obonisa okungasemva njengendawo yokuzoba kuzalisa iindawo zawo ezibonisa okungasemva ngombala wangasemva wangoku. Umfanekiso ofakiweyo uhlala ulukhetho oludadayo; iindawo zawo ezibonisa okungasemva ziveza indawo yokuzoba esele ikhona xa uqinisekisiwe. Imifanekiso engeniswe kwi-Wikimedia Commons ifumana umaleko omhlophe ngasemva phambi kokufakwa. Iifayile zokuqala zomthombo azitshintshi.

Ukubuka > Zulazula: tsala ngomnwe omnye ukuze uhambise okubonwayo, sondeza okanye wahlule iminwe emibini ukuze uguqule ubungakanani bokubuka uze uhambise okubonwayo. Khetha Buyela ekuzobeni kukhetho luka-Zulazula, okanye ukhethe isixhobo sokuzoba, ukuze ubuyele ekuzobeni. Ukuzulazula ngeminwe emibini kuyasebenza nakwizixhobo zokuzoba ngaphandle kokushiya amanqaku epeyinti. Isilayidi esisezantsi ngasekunene sinomgca ophakathi kwi-100%. Amaqhosha okusondeza/okubuyisela kude amisa kwi-100% xa inyathelo lingayidlula; cofa kwakhona ukuze uqhubeke. Iqhosha elikufutshane elithi Lungisa ubungakanani bokubuka ukuze kulingane lenza indawo yokuzoba nalo naluphi na ukhetho oludadayo zilingane zize zibe sembindini wemboniselo. Zulazula ikwanika i-100%; Ukubuka inika igridi yeepikseli.

Ukugcina ngokuzenzekela kubhala umsebenzi wangoku ongekagqitywa emva kokuma kancinci ekuhleleni, naxa uphuma kwi-app. Imeko ibonisa Umsebenzi ongekagqitywa ugciniwe okanye impazamo yokugcina ngokuzenzekela. Ukuvula kwakhona kubuyisela umsebenzi ongekagqitywa, igama lefayile, imimiselo yezixhobo, ukhetho oludadayo neemilo ezingagqitywanga. Ukugcina ngokuzenzekela kugcina umsebenzi wabucala ongekagqitywa. Ifayile inika i-PNG, i-JPEG ne-HEIC ezinomgangatho onokulungiswa, ne-JPEG XL, WebP ne-AVIF ezilahla okanye ezingalahli datha. Gcina njenge ikhetha ifomathi yomfanekiso, imimiselo nendawo; Gcina ibhala apho kwakhona. Khuphela ngaphandle njenge kunye no-Gcina uze wabelane zibhala ikopi ngaphandle kokuguqula indawo yangoku ka-Gcina okanye ukumakisha umzobo njengogciniweyo. Gcina uze wabelane ivula ukwabelana kwe-Android emva koko. Inkwenkwezi kwigama lefayile ithetha ukuba umzobo unotshintsho olungagcinwanga. Ukugcina ngokuzenzekela akuze kubhale phezu kwemifanekiso yomthombo.

Ukhetho: zoba uxande okanye umda ngokukhululekileyo. Tsala ngaphakathi ukuze uhambise, tsala ikona esisikwere okanye umbindi womphetho ukuze uguqule ubungakanani, okanye utsale isiphatho esingqukuva esithi Jikelezisa ukuze ujikelezise. Tshixa imilinganiselo ivuliwe ngokuzenzekela; yicime ukuze wolule ububanzi nobude ngokwahlukeneyo. Iziphatho zemiphetho ziguqula ubungakanani kwicala elikhethiweyo. Ukhetho oluzotywe ngokukhululekileyo lugcina imilo yalo ekhethiweyo ngaphakathi kwebhokisi yokuguqula, nasemva kokujikelezisa nokugcina ngokuzenzekela. Ubukhulu ne-engile zibonakala kwiphaneli yokhetho. Qinisekisa indawo ekhethiweyo isebenzisa iziphumo; uhlengahlengiso lokhetho lunokuhlehliswa, kwaye ukugcina ngokuzenzekela kugcina iinguqu ezingagqitywanga. Khuphela, Sika kunye no-Nquma ukuya kwindawo ekhethiweyo zisebenzisa umfanekiso oguquliweyo. Khetha konke iphantsi kokuthi Hlela > Ukhetho, kwaye Ctrl+A iyasebenza kwikhibhodi yangaphandle. Sika, Khuphela no-Ncamathisela zizenzo ezikhawulezayo kwiheader. Iimaski zokhetho zigcina imilo ekhethiweyo; uxwebhu ngokwalo alubonisi okungasemva.

Imida yendawo yokuzoba: tsala iziphatho ngaphakathi ukuze unqume okanye ngaphandle ukuze wandise nakweliphi na icala, uze ukhethe Sebenzisa imida. Indawo entsha isebenzisa umbala wangasemva; iipikseli esele zikhona aziguqulwa ngobungakanani. Rhoxisa no-Hlehlisa ziyafumaneka. Guqula ubungakanani bomfanekiso, Isayizi yesiKrini sokuZobela no-Umfanekiso omtsha zamkela ii-Pixels okanye Ipesenti, zinokhetho lokutshixa umlinganiselo.

Umgca ogobileyo: zoba umgca uze utsale kabini ukuze uwugobe. Ipholigoni: cofa iincam, uze ucofe incam yokugqibela kabini okanye usebenzise Gqibezela ipholigoni. Cima Dibanisa ichaphaza lokugqibela nelokuqala ukuze uzobe amacandelo avulekileyo adityanisiweyo. Uxande oluneekona ezingqukuva: misela Umgama ukusuka embindini ukuya kumda wesangqa (px) ngesilayidi sawo; imilo nganye iwunciphisa ukuba ungadluli kwisiqingatha secala layo elifutshane. Umbhalo: cofa indawo yokuzoba, ukhethe ifonti eboniswe ngesimbo sayo uze usebenzise imboniselo etshintsha ngoko nangoko. Ukhetho luquka ubungakanani, ukutyeba, ukukekela, ukukrwelela ngaphantsi, umgca phakathi kombhalo, ulungelelwaniso, izithuba zemigca nebhokisi yombhalo enombala wangasemva. Ipeyinti yamanzi ikudidi Umzobo ecaleni kwe-iBhrashi ne-Ibhrashi yomoya; lungisa amandla ukuze imigca ithambe. Izilayidi zobungakanani bepensile, bebrashi nezixhobo zifikelela kwiipikseli ezili-100. Ipensile iqala kwipikseli e-1 kwaye ikhumbula ububanzi bayo. Cofa inani elibonisiweyo ukuze ufake inani elichanekileyo. Intliziyo, Inkwenkwezi no-Utolo zinokhetho olufanayo lomda/lokugcwalisa njengezinye iimilo. Ukubuka > Ukuzoba ngesalathisi ivula iswitshi yokuyenza isebenze, imilo yesalathisi nemimiselo yesikhulisi. Tsala ukuze ubeke isalathisi, cofa iqhosha lokuzoba elisesikrinini, uze uhambise okubonwayo ukuze uzobe. Cofa kwakhona ukuze uyeke ukuzoba. Imimiselo yebrashi neyemigca ihlala phantsi kokuthi Zoba > Umzobo. Ukubuka > Isikhulisi ikuvumela ukuba uvule imboniselo eyandisiweyo yesalathisi okanye yendawo yokuzoba uze ulungise ubungakanani bokwandisa kwayo. Imimiselo yokuzoba ikwanika ukugudisa imiphetho yeepikseli nokugudisa imigca. Iifonti ezongezelelweyo ezilishumi elinanye zifakiwe; Iilayisenisi zeefonti zineenkcukacha zabanikeli bazo nemiqathango epheleleyo.

Ifayile > Layisha umfanekiso ithatha indawo yendawo yokuzoba ngesikhethi se-Android. «Zoba → Faka → Eminye imifanekiso» inika iifayile zesixhobo, i-Catrobat, i-Irasutoya, i-Openclipart ne-“Wikimedia Commons · Iimephu ezingenanto…”. Khetha umfanekiso wesixhobo, okanye uvule iphepha lomsebenzi wobugcisa elikwi-intanethi uze ucofe «Sebenzisa umfanekiso», ukuze wongeze umfanekiso njengokhetho oludadayo. Ifayile > Malunga, iilayisenisi nombulelo > Abadali bemifanekiso igcina amakhonkco emithombo nesaziso selayisenisi. Imifanekiso engaphakathi komda wenkumbulo yesixhobo ilayishwa kwi-resolution yokuqala. Xa kufuneka, incoko yokukhetha ubungakanani ibonisa ubukhulu, inani leepikseli noqikelelo lwenkumbulo, inobungakanani ngee-Pixels/ngePesenti nokhetho lokutshixa umlinganiselo. Ifayile yokuqala ayitshintshi.

«Ifayile» > Ukudibanisa imifanekiso ivula indawo yokusebenza eyahlukileyo yemifanekiso efikelela kuma-20. Hlela imifanekiso emincinane ngegama lefayile okanye ngexesha. Nquma umfanekiso omnye okanye unqume emininzi kunye. Ububanzi obufanayo / Ubude obufanayo bulinganisa yonke imifanekiso elayishiweyo ngoxa kugcinwa imilinganiselo yobubanzi nobude. Tsala imifanekiso emincinane okanye ebekiweyo ukuze incamathele ngasekunene/kulungelelaniswe phezulu okanye ngezantsi/kulungelelaniswe ekhohlo. Indawo echanekileyo imisela ikona ephezulu ngasekhohlo ngeepikseli ezipheleleyo eziqala kuziro, igcina eminye imifanekiso kwiindawo zayo ize ivumele ukugqumana. Imifanekiso engeniswe kamva izotywa ngaphezulu. Susa ekubekweni isusa kuphela ukubekwa okukhethiweyo. Eminye imifanekiso ihlala ibekiwe; encanyathiselweyo ingahamba ukuze ivale umsantsa. «Bonisa konke» ilungisa ubungakanani bokubuka. Gcina i-PNG ikhuphela ngaphandle ingqokelela; Hlela kwi-Paint iyidlulisela njengohlengahlengiso olunokuhlehliswa. I-app isebenzisa umhleli omnye wemifanekiso engabonisi okungasemva. Ukudibanisa imifanekiso yindawo yokulungiselela eyahlukileyo.

Iphaneli ethi «Ifayile > Malunga, iilayisenisi nombulelo» iquka amalungelo okushicilela okuqala, iinkcukacha zabanikeli bezinto/zeefonti, umbhalo opheleleyo welayisenisi nekhowudi yomthombo epheleleyo yale nguqulelo. Umbhalo welayisenisi uskrola ngokuzimeleyo kumaqhosha angashukumiyo athi Khuphela konke, Eminye imiqathango no-Kugqityiwe.

Khetha ithebhu ukuze ubonise izilawuli zayo. Ukubuka iqala ngo-Zulazula; Zoba iquka Umzobo, Ukhetho no-Faka. Imifanekiso efakiweyo ihlala ikhethiwe; imboniselo ibonisa iziphatho zayo nangaphandle kwendawo yokuzoba. Lungisa ubungakanani bomfanekiso ukuze ulingane kwindawo yokuzoba iguqula ukubekwa; Ubungakanani bokuqala ibuyisela ubukhulu bomthombo. Ukugcina ngokuzenzekela kubuyisela umsebenzi ongekagqitywa nazo zombini izintlu zika-Hlehlisa/Phinda wenze xa uphinda uvule i-app. Ifayile ikwaquka ukudibanisa imifanekiso, Indlela yokusebenzisa, kunye no-Malunga, iilayisenisi nombulelo.
